plan.title: bug(upgrade,xbrief): upgrade keeps vbrief/ behind a DEPRECATED.md marker when vbrief/ and xbrief/ both have content, and the marker fails the pre-commit drift gate

narratives.Description: OVPR fix plan unit P2-U13 (story id ovpr-p2-u13), spec units/P2-U13-upgrade-finishes-vbrief-move.md, issue #6571. Today, when vbrief/ and xbrief/ both have content, or vbrief/ already has a DEPRECATED.md marker, upgrade keeps vbrief/ and writes the marker, and the upgrade commit then fails `verify:xbrief-drift --staged`. In packages/core/src/xbrief-migrate/migrate-project.ts the upgrade path now migrates each leftover file, skips identical ones, copies conflicting ones to xbrief/archive/, and deletes vbrief/. The drift gate does not change.
narratives.Overview:
## Summary

When `vbrief/` and `xbrief/` both have content (for example after an earlier partial migration), `directive upgrade` keeps `vbrief/` and writes `vbrief/DEPRECATED.md` instead of finishing the move. The pre-commit gate `verify:xbrief-drift --staged` then rejects that new marker, so the upgrade commit fails. A repo that was marked earlier stays marked on every later upgrade.

## Evidence

- Consumer report: #6465, comment "Two more regressions", item 2 (deftai/evolution, 0.129.11).
- Migration (`packages/core/src/xbrief-migrate/migrate-project.ts`, origin/master `d645489e6`): the normal case converts into `xbrief/`, archives unconvertible files to `xbrief/archive/`, and deletes `vbrief/` (`:730-775`). The dual-populated case keeps `vbrief/` and writes the marker (`:978-989`, #2270). The already-marked case leaves it (`:942-955`).
- Gate: `drift-gate.ts:304` flags any added/modified path under `vbrief/`. Deletions are not checked (`encoding/git.ts:37`, `--diff-filter=ACMR`).
- Correction to the report: the allowlist default did not change. `allowList: null` and `BUILTIN_ALLOW_LIST` are identical in v0.126.2 and origin/master.

## Expected

After `directive upgrade`, `vbrief/` is gone in every case. Leftover files are migrated into `xbrief/` when the destination is free, skipped when already identical, and copied raw to `xbrief/archive/` when they differ. Existing `xbrief/` files are never overwritten. The drift gate is unchanged. `--keep-legacy` on a direct `deft migrate:xbrief` stays as an explicit opt-in.

## Ordering

Must merge before plan unit P2-U1 (#5808 / #5976), which restores `verify:xbrief-drift` in the pre-commit template.

## Ownership

OVPR / installer (upgrade is the only path that migrates project data, AC7.8). Plan unit P2-U13. Decision D-012 (polfer, 2026-11-17).

## Refs

#6465, #2270, #5808, #5976.

narratives.ImplementationPlan:
1. In packages/core/src/xbrief-migrate/migrate-project.ts, when keepLegacy is false (the upgrade path never passes it), handle the dual-populated case per legacy file: compute destRelForLegacy; destination free → write it as the normal path does; destination taken with identical converted content → skip; content differs → copy the raw file to archiveDestRelative under xbrief/archive/ and never overwrite; an archive collision fails closed with today's error. Then delete vbrief/, including DEPRECATED.md.
2. Handle the already-marked (xbrief-marker) case the same way, and keep the residual-envelope rewrite for xbrief/.
3. Remove an empty vbrief/. Keep the backup, staging and fail-closed behaviour, and report counts: migrated, already present, archived on collision, archived as unconvertible.
4. Keep --keep-legacy on a direct deft migrate:xbrief run, and add a test that the upgrade path passes keepLegacy false.
5. Tests in packages/core/src/xbrief-migrate/migrate-project.test.ts for each case in the spec, including an end-to-end check that verify:xbrief-drift --staged exits 0 after the migration. No change to drift-gate.ts.
6. Changelog fragment changelog.d/6571-upgrade-removes-vbrief.md.
narratives.Constraint:
- Never overwrite an existing `xbrief/` file with legacy content.
- Never drop a legacy file that differs from what's in `xbrief/`: it goes to `xbrief/archive/`.
- Don't add a `vbrief/` exemption to the drift gate; no change to `drift-gate.ts`.
- Don't change repair or automatic setup: they never migrate (AC6.8).
- Don't edit the pre-commit template here (P2-U1 owns it).
- OVPR change gate: read ~/Projects/directive-ovpr-planning-202611/OVPR-CHANGE-GATE.md. Do not edit docs/installer-refactor-ovpr/ and do not ship behaviour that departs from the written OVPR requirements or architecture; stop that part and hand back a change proposal.
- Changelog: add the changelog.d fragment named in file_scope; never edit CHANGELOG.md.

narratives.UserStory: As a developer upgrading an old Directive repo, I want the upgrade to finish moving vbrief/ into xbrief/ even when both folders have content, so that no vbrief/ folder is left behind and the upgrade commit passes the drift gate.

items.title: After `directive upgrade`, no `vbrief/` folder remains, in the normal, dual-populated and already-marked cases.

items.title: No existing `xbrief/` content is overwritten; every legacy file is migrated, already present, or in `xbrief/archive/`.

narrative.Acceptance: Given legacy files whose xbrief destination already exists, when the upgrade migration runs, then no existing `xbrief/` file changes, and every legacy file is migrated, already present, or stored in `xbrief/archive/`.

items.title: The upgrade commit passes `verify:xbrief-drift --staged` with no `--allow-list`.

narrative.Acceptance: Given a dual-populated repo after the upgrade migration, when `verify:xbrief-drift --staged` runs with no `--allow-list`, then it exits 0.
Given the PR diff, when `drift-gate.ts` is compared with the merge base, then it shows no change.
